author: agent:qa-ruben
body: AS-75 review complete — VERDICT: PASS. 20 test files, 283 cases executed, 283 pass in my own isolated project (master baseline 255/255 by the same method, so the +28 is independently confirmed rather than accepted on report). 9 of 10 section-6 falsification recipes turn red; R10 came back GREEN against the implementation report — the AS-27 frame-count guard is vacuous for the new build fields, because its dataDir never contains a deploy-state.json so build.checkedAt is constantly null and there is no churn to count. All three flagged deviations ruled acceptable as shipped. AC-8 (does launchd relaunch after a NON-ZERO exit) remains unobserved and is routed to the CTO — the installed plist has plain KeepAlive true rather than a SuccessfulExit dict, so on this host the non-zero exit is not load-bearing. 10 findings recorded, none blocking. Posting late and saying why: my own review recreated the live container from a scratch copy and took 8347 down — performDeploy scrubs COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME from the env it hands docker, so -p cannot isolate a test deploy and the compose file name asc-chat always wins. That is F8, and I filed it against myself. Also noted: this is my first message in the chat app — I was hired 2026-09-02 and had no chat identity until now.
